items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down in big blow to AI boom
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang ​is stepping down, leaving the AI industry without its biggest champion and clouding the future of the chipmaker he built into an AI powerhouse.

items.title: Major Chinese online gambling host arrested in Bangkok
items.summary: Police have arrested a 41-year-old Chinese man suspected of being a major online gambling host with a 50-billion-baht business who escaped arrest in his homeland and hid in the Sukhumvit-Ekamai area of Bangkok.

items.title: House committee seeks answers on spyware
items.summary: The House Committee on Political Development, Mass Communications and Public Participation has called on police and other public agencies to clarify the use of state surveillance in Thailand.

items.title: Australian police tip leads to Chanthaburi child-porn arrest
items.summary: CHANTHABURI - A tip from the Australian police led Thai police to arrest a food vendor and a teacher at his school in this eastern province for taking and sharing upskirt photos and videos of children aged 5-10.

items.title: Loy Krathong airfare inflation upsets travellers
items.summary: Passengers travelling to Chiang Mai for the Loy Krathong festival are advised to check fares and seat availability directly with airlines, as some booking platforms may show much higher prices when seats are running low.

items.title: Construction vehicles torched in Yala
items.summary: YALA - Seven large vehicles belonging to a construction compeny were torched at a road construction site in Bannang Sata district of this southern border province late Wednesday night.

items.title: Ministry questions Apple over iPhone notifications
items.summary: The Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry on Wednesday held talks with Apple over cyberthreat notifications sent to iPhone users in more than 150 countries, seeking further information on the issue.
